title: AID Test Portfolio — Quarantine Remediation Evidence
$comment: producer: scripts/tests/test-integration-quarantine-remediation-evidence.sh (P069 Step 15); consumer: Step 18's PM quarantine-decision review, which cites the fixed, retained path .aid-o/work/evidence/quarantine-remediation/<gate_id>-<commit_sha>.json. Addresses every gate-specific quarantine-exit criterion from the original roadmap (docs/plans/P066-test-portfolio-audit-scheduler-remediation.md §6): membership agreement, no shared-state corruption, streamed failure diagnostics, resume-without-orphan/duplicate, and a measured (never invented) runtime figure. Asserts no pass/fail runtime target itself — the PM ratifies the real number.

gate_id.description: The quarantined gate this bundle addresses (e.g. "bats_all"). One bundle per gate — this plan never conflates two quarantined gates into one bundle (see plan_diff_scope_note: plan_diff is explicitly out of scope, never silently rolled into this gate's own evidence).

commit_sha.description: The commit this evidence was measured against — part of the retained artifact's own filename (<gate_id>-<commit_sha>.json).

run_units_expected.description: ALWAYS re-derived from the live .aid-o/config/test-catalog.yaml at measurement time — never a hardcoded constant (P066's own originally-planned "88" had already drifted to 83 by P066's release, confirming a fixed number in a schema/plan is unreliable by construction).

run_units_observed.description: The count of run_units this bundle's underlying divergence-evidence/timing data actually covers.

cross_check_sources.description: Paths to the retained artifacts this bundle's membership-agreement claim is cross-checked against — e.g. .aid-o/work/evidence/scheduler-divergence/<commit>-<mode>-<run_id>.json entries, and/or the P066 Step 7 lock-audit result.

severity.description: blocking → quarantine_lift_blocked MUST be true; a shared-state/corruption finding is never silently smoothed over into a clean bundle.

evidence_ref.description: Path to the artifact/log this finding is grounded in.

shared_state_findings.description: Empty array = no shared-state finding observed. Never omitted (an absent array would be indistinguishable from "not checked").

example_log_path.description: Path to a real, retained example of a streamed (not buffered-until-batch-end) failure diagnostic. Empty string permitted only when proven:false.

evidence_path.description: Path to real evidence that a resumed/retried run reaches a terminal receipt for every unit with zero orphaned process groups and zero duplicate receipts. Empty string permitted only when proven:false.

sequential_ms.description: Real, measured wall-clock duration of the sequential run — never invented, never the pre-remediation ~29-70 min baseline restated.

scheduled_ms.description: Real, measured wall-clock duration of the scheduled (mode_tested) run.

measured_runtime_ms.description: No target runtime number is asserted as a pass/fail AC anywhere in this schema — the real measured figures are reported for PM ratification (Constraint 9), never an invented '≤20 min' style threshold.

quarantine_lift_blocked.description: true iff ANY shared_state_findings[] entry has severity:"blocking", OR the underlying divergence evidence (membership_diff/verdict_diff) was non-empty (pass:false) — computed, never hand-set to false to force a clean-looking bundle.

plan_diff_scope_note.const: plan_diff is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this plan (P069). Its documented root cause (aid-plan-diff.sh's outer gate timeout equals its own internal per-AC timeout, so nested bats invocations exhaust the budget) is a timeout-architecture problem, not a scheduling/parallelism problem, and remains unaddressed by this bundle or this plan.
plan_diff_scope_note.description: Fixed string — this bundle explicitly states plan_diff is out of scope rather than silently omitting it.
